scope: Single-machine smoke checks; not a comprehensive benchmark

hardware.cpu: Intel Core i5, six cores, 3.7 GHz

observations.request: Explain why the sky is blue in two sentences
observations.answer_check: Readable English describing wavelength-dependent Rayleigh scattering

observations.request: Python function returning the largest number in a nonempty list
observations.answer_check: Requested function logic present; generated code was not executed

observations.request: Name the three primary colors of light
observations.note: Checked again after installation as a LaunchAgent

gpu_counters.scope: GPU-wide counters; include other applications and are not process-exclusive

privacy: No raw logs, personal prompts, unique hardware identifiers, or local paths included

hermes_prompt.method: Offline prompt assembly and llama.cpp tokenization of a greeting with the compact terminal/file tool schemas. No Hermes chat session or generation was run for this check.

responsive_tuning.note: Short direct API measurements with other desktop applications open. No Hermes session was launched. This is not a full-window latency or desktop frame-time benchmark.
